name: ace of cups
symbols: a cup overflowing in five streams
the dove descending with the wafer
a hand offering it from the cloud, palm open
themes: feeling offered before it is deserved or earned
the heart's capacity arriving unasked
an opening that only requires acceptance
shadow: letting the cup pass because receiving feels like debt
spilling it early to control the overflow
charge: something is being offered. what makes you check the price tag first?
voice_note: open-handed register. the reading is whether they can take the cup without negotiating.

name: two of cups
symbols: two cups exchanged at eye level
the winged lion over the caduceus
a house on the hill behind, unnoticed by both
themes: mutual recognition, cup for cup
the vow underneath the transaction
meeting as equals or not at all
shadow: keeping the ledger of who poured more
merging so completely the second cup goes missing
charge: in the exchange you are thinking of — what do you pour, and what do you actually receive?
voice_note: tender but precise. this one is about the terms under the affection.

name: three of cups
symbols: three cups raised in a circle
the harvest underfoot mid-dance
no one leading, no one watching
themes: joy that requires company
the friends who hold the story of you
celebration as maintenance, not luxury
shadow: being everyone's toast and no one's confession
the circle kept light so nothing real gets said
charge: who raises a cup when it goes well for you — and who would you actually call when it doesn't?
voice_note: warm. find whether the circle is real or choreography.

name: four of cups
symbols: arms folded under a tree
three cups already lined up, gone flat
a fourth offered from the air, unregarded
themes: the discontent that cannot name what it wants
refusing what is offered because it is not what was lost
apathy as a stalled grief
shadow: curating dissatisfaction as a personality
missing the new cup while auditing the old three
charge: there is a fourth cup at your elbow. what would it cost you to look at it?
voice_note: do not cheerlead. sit under the tree with them first, then tilt the head toward the offered thing.

name: five of cups
symbols: a black cloak turned to face the spilled three
two cups still standing behind the heels
a bridge crossing to the house, in plain view
themes: grief given its full attention
the loss that reorganized everything
what remains, waiting at the back
shadow: tending the spill so long it becomes the address
refusing the two cups because they are not the three
charge: when you finally turn around, what do you expect to still be standing?
voice_note: never rush the mourner. name the spilled cups honestly before ever mentioning the two.

name: six of cups
symbols: a cup of flowers handed down to a smaller figure
a courtyard from an older, safer year
the guard walking away in the background
themes: the past as a source of sweetness or a residence
what childhood still hands you daily
innocence remembered, accurately or not
shadow: living at an address you moved out of years ago
editing the memory until it flatters
charge: what does the child you were keep handing you — and do you take it as a gift or as instructions?
voice_note: nostalgic warmth with one eyebrow raised. ask what the courtyard actually smelled like.

name: seven of cups
symbols: seven cups arranged on a cloud
a castle, a wreath, a dragon, a shrouded figure glowing
the chooser in silhouette, still empty-handed
themes: options multiplying instead of resolving
fantasy as a comfortable waiting room
the choice avoided by admiring the menu
shadow: window-shopping lives instead of living one
the shrouded cup chosen never, examined always
charge: if six of these vanished at dawn, which one would you grieve?
voice_note: dreamy at first, then one clean edge: make the menu name its main course.

name: eight of cups
symbols: eight cups stacked with one gap in the row
a figure already walking into the hills
the moon watching the departure it predicted
themes: the leaving that is already underway inside
walking away from what was built and still works
the search that outranks the settlement
shadow: leaving every table just before the meal
calling it seeking when it is fleeing
charge: the stack is tidy and something is missing from it. when did you first notice the gap?
voice_note: orderly, unannounced register. surface the question under the question here: not whether to go — whether they are allowed.

name: nine of cups
symbols: nine cups arced like a trophy shelf
arms crossed, smile fixed, bench small
blue cloth hiding whatever the shelf stands on
themes: the wish granted, publicly
satisfaction displayed and possibly felt
plenty as a posture
shadow: the smile that is also a wall
wanting the wanting back once the wish lands
charge: you got the thing. why does the bench feel small when you sit with it?
voice_note: congratulate first, honestly. then ask what is under the blue cloth.

name: ten of cups
symbols: a rainbow of cups over a small house
two figures with arms wide, two children dancing
the river running past the garden, not through it
themes: the whole picture, briefly assembled
family as achievement and weather
contentment that includes everyone in frame
shadow: staging the postcard while living off-camera
guarding the picture so hard no one may move in it
charge: who is in your picture of enough — and have you told them they are in it?
voice_note: full warmth. the read is the distance between their picture and their week.

name: page of cups
symbols: a fish looking up out of the cup
a tunic printed with tulips
the sea behind, kept casual
themes: feeling arriving with a strange face
the invitation to take the odd thing seriously
tenderness practiced in small, unguarded ways
shadow: laughing off the message because it surfaced funny
sensitivity performed instead of felt
charge: something unexpected has been surfacing in you lately. what happens if you greet it instead of blinking?
voice_note: light touch, real attention. the fish is the tell — ask what oddness they have been dismissing.

name: knight of cups
symbols: a cup carried level at a walking pace
wings on the helmet, none on the horse
a river crossed by looking for the ford
themes: the offer made ceremonially
romance as a quest with terms
feeling brought forward slowly, on purpose
shadow: in love with the approach, allergic to the arrival
the proposal that is really a performance
charge: what are you carrying toward someone at walking pace — and why not knock yet?
voice_note: courtly register, lightly teased. ask what happens after the cup is handed over.

name: queen of cups
symbols: a lidded cup, the only closed one in the suit
a throne at the exact tideline
shells and stone children listening at the armrests
themes: feeling held with both hands and studied
the confidante everyone finds
depth managed with grace
shadow: holding everyone's water and telling no one about the lid
reading the room so well the self goes unread
charge: your cup is the only one with a lid on it. who is allowed to look inside?
voice_note: she will read you back. quiet, level, no tricks — ask about the lid only when the room is soft.

name: king of cups
symbols: a throne floating steady on open sea
a ship in the swell behind, unremarked
the cup held, the whale passing
themes: calm kept while the water moves
feeling governed without being denied
steadiness as a gift to everyone else
shadow: regulation hardened into distance
the storm rerouted inward where no one files a report
charge: the sea moves and you do not. where does your weather actually go?
voice_note: match the calm, then name it as work. this one has been strong at sea a long time.
